You hear part of an announcement in a ward.
 Why is the announcement being given at this time?
A. It is a routine announcement given before every briefing.
B. It is being given because of an accident in the hospital.
C. It is being because of the rise of a certain infectious disease.

You hear part of a training for nurses on medication errors.
 What is the overall topic of the training?
A. Being able to explain the causes of most medication errors
B. Being able to acquire knowledge and skill in managing errors
C. Being able to demonstrate how to investigate medication errors

 What do the two nurses agree on about the training?

B. That it was not necessary to include some topics
C. That not everyone needed to take the training

 How does the senior doctor help the trainee doctor to interpret the ECG?

B. By asking her to explain the different parts of the ECG recording
C. By asking her to show him the different parts of the ECG recording
